stringLengthInterpretation: Unicode code points; not UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units
numberInterpretation: Exact decimal NUMBER(p,s), without rounding. Trailing zeroes and equivalent exponent notation do not change the value.

timestamp.collectDate: YYYYMMDDhhmmss; valid calendar date and clock time

vds.optionalWhenPresent: Must have numeric type and satisfy precision/scale. Null and string coercion are not allowed.

utic.envelope: Retain adopted UTIC API result/record XML envelope and field spelling
utic.locationTypeAuthority: Literal table 4-16 values; C1013 is not silently corrected to C0103
utic.optionalAbsence: sourceCode is O; locationTypeCd/locationData have M/O '-'. Do not require their presence or invent geometry syntax.
utic.retainedChecks: Required fields, required string lengths, dates and existing enumerated codes

limits: Does not implement collection/update period assessment
Does not resolve remaining standard/API envelope differences
Does not repair the separate evidence-review comparator or integrate review into the engine
